m: निर्-√ मा Ā. -मिमीते, TS. : AV.; Br.; -माति, Kāv.; Pur. (pf. -ममे, Mn.; MBh.; ind.p. -माय, Prab.; inf. -मातुम्, Rājat.); to mete out, measure, AV.; to build, make out of (abl.), form, fabricate, produce, create, TS.; Br.; Mn. &c.; (with चित्रम्) to paint, Śak.; Daś.; (with कोशम्) to compose or write, Cat.; (with गिरम्) to utter, Kull.; (with नीतिम्) to show, betray, MBh. : Pass. -मीयते (pf. -ममे, Rājat. v, 425; aor. -अमायि, Cat.), to be measured out &c.: Caus. -मापयति, to cause to be made or built, Rājat.; Kathās. : Desid. -मित्सति, to wish to make or build, Naiṣ.
निर्-˚मा f. value, measure, equivalent, Lāṭy.
a: निर्मा — {c3c} A., {c2c} P. 1 To make, create, bring into existence; निर्मातुं प्रभवेन्मनोहरमिदं रूपं पुराणो मुनिः V. 1. 9; यस्मादेष सुरेंद्राणां मात्राभ्यो निर्मितो नृपः Ms. 7. 5; 1. 13. --2 (a) To build, form, construct; स्नायुनिर्मिता एते पाशाः H. 1 (b) To cause to be settled, colonize (as a town &c.); निर्ममे निर्ममोऽ र्थेषु मथुरां मधुराकृतिः R. 15. 28. --3 To cause, produce; शलाकांजननिर्मितेव Ku. 1. 47. --4 To compose, write; स्वनिर्मितया टीकया समेतं काव्यं. --5 To prepare, manufacture in general.

a: निर्माणं — 1 Measuring, meting out; यतश्चाध्वकालनिर्मार्णं P. I. 4. 31 Vārt. --2 Measure, reach, extent; अयमप्राप्तनिर्माणः (बालः) Rām. ‘not having reached the full measure of growth’. --3 Producing, forming, making, creation, formation, manufacture; ईदृशो निर्माणभागः परिणतः U. 4. --4 A creation, created thing or object, form; निर्माणमेव हि तदादरलालनीयं Māl. 9. 49. --5 A shape, make, figure; शरीरनिर्माणसदृशो नन्वस्यानुभावः Mv. 1. --6 Composition, work. --7 A building. --8 A part, portion. --9 Essence, pith, marrow. --10 (With Buddhists) Transformation. --णा Fitness, propriety, decorum.

निर्—माल्या f. Trigonella Corniculata, L.

v: na॰ nir + mala--Ryat । devadatte tadvisarjanottaramucCizwe dravye “arvAk visarjanAddravyaM nEvedyaM sarvamucyate । visarjite jagannATe nirmAlyaM Bavati kzaRAt” gAruqapu॰ । vidyAnandanibanDe “sUryye gaRApatAvugre SAkte SEve'Ta vEzRave । tejaScaRqamaTocCizwasojamucCizwapUrvikAm । cARqAlIM SezikAM caRqaM viSvaksenaM kramAdyajet । sojo gaReSaH । “hfdaye ca bahirdevIM samarpya viDivattataH । nirmAlyaYca SucO deSe nEvedyaM Bakzayet suDIH” tantrAntare A॰ ta॰ nirmAlyasya DAraRaprakArAdikaM nirUpitaM yaTA “nirmAlyaM SirasA DAryyaM sarvANge cAnulepanam । nEvedyaYcopaBuYjIta dattvA tadBaktiSAline” । tadBaktiSAline vizvaksenAdaye “udvAsya devaM sve GAmni tanniveditamagrataH । adyAdAtmaviSudDyarTaM sarvakAmasamfdDaye” । Ke DAmni svIyahadaye udvAsya saMsTApya taTAca kAlikApurARe “DyAyaMstu mantreRAnena tatrasTaM sTApayet hfdi । tizWa devi! pare sTAne svasTAnaM parameSvari । yatra brahmAdayaH sarbe surAstizWanti me hfdi” । Bavizye “nirmAlyaM nopaBoktavyaM rudrasya tapanasya ca । Bakzyate yadi tanmohAnnarake pacyate Druvam” । nirmAlyamAtre tu “udake tarumUle vA nirmAlyaM tasya saMtyajet” kAlikApurARe “yo yaddevArccanarataH sa tannEvedyaBakzakaH” brahmapu॰ “ambarIza! navaM vastraM PalamanyadrasAdikam । kftvA kfzRopaBogyantu sadA sevyaM hi vEzRavEH” tatrEkakarttari ktvASravaRAt svadattanEvedyaBakzaRe'pyaDikAra uktaH “kevalaM sOraSEve tu vEzRavo nEva Bakzayet” । vizRuyAmale “pItvA pAdodakaM devi! nEvedyaM svayamudDaret । tyajet pAdodakaM yastu nEvedyaM vA tyajecca yaH । zazwivarzasahasrARi rOrave narake pacet” । udDaret aByavaharet । skandayAmale “udvAsya devaM sve GAmni tanniveditamAtsanaH । Bakzayet pApaSudDyarTaM sarvadA sADakaH priye!” SivaDarmottare rudranEvedyaBakzaRamuktaM yaTA “aTa BaktyA SivaM pUjya nEvedyamupakalpayet । tadannaM svayamaSnIyAt tat sarvaM vinivedayet” । “PalaM puzpaYca tAmbUlam annapAnAdikaYca yat । adattvAtanmahAdevyE na BoktavyaM kadAcana” । etena yat paWanti “anyadevasya nEvedyaM BuktvA cAndrAyaRaYcaret” iti tadekAntavEzRavaparamiti BUzaRaH । yattu “SUdrAnnaM yAjakAnnaYca nEvedyaYcApi varjayet” iti lENgavacanam । tannEvedyatvenopakalpitAniveditaparaM loBAdinA BojananizeDakaM vA yaToktaM SAmbe “nopaBuktvA ca nEvedyaM prayAti pretayonizu .” drayyaviSezasya kAlaBede nirmAlyatoktA tantrasA॰ yoginItantre yaTA “maRimuktA suvarRAni deve dattAni yAni vE । na nirmAlyaM dvAdaRAvdaM tAmrapAtraM taTEva ca । pawwaSAwI ca zaRmAsaM nEvedyaM dattamAtrataH । modakaM kfzaraYcEva mAsArdDena maheSvari! pawwavastra trimAsAcca yAtayAmamahaH smftam । yAvaduzRaM BavedannaM paramAnnaM taTEva ca । mastakaM ruDiraYcEva ahorAtreRa pArvati! । muhUrttandaDi dugDaYca AjyaM yAmena SaNkari । karavIramahorAtraM vilvapatraM taTEva ca । javAraktaYca mAGyaM ca nirmAlyaM sArdDayAmake । mAlyaM vE karavIrasya padmasya vilvajasya ca । yAmArdDena maheSAni! tAmbUlaM dattamAtrataH । anirmAlyaYca dAqimbaM taTA vilvaPalaM priye! । sOganDikaYca kadalIM prayatnena niyojayet । kadalIvIjapUraYca dugDapakvaM nivedayet .” SivanirmAlyaDAraRe viSezaH ti॰ ta॰ ukto yaTA skAnde “nirmAlyaM yo hi madBaktyA SirasA DArayizyati । aSucirBinnamaryyAdo naraH pApasamanvitaH । narake pacyate Gore tiryyagyonO ca jAyate । brahmahApi SucirmUtvA nirmAlyaM yastu DArayet । tasya pApaM mahacCIvraM nASayizye mahAvrate! .” SuciHsnAnAdineti SezaH । evaYca “spfzwvA rudrasya nirmAlyaM savAsA AplutaH SuciH” iti kAlikApurARIyamaSucivizayam । anupanItavizayamiti SrIdattaH । bahvfcagfhyapariSizwam । agrAhyaM SibanEvedyaM patraM puzpaM PalaM jalam । SAlagrAmaSilAsparSAt sarvaM yAti pavitratAm” udake nirmAlyatyAgaSca naNgetaraparaH । yaToktaM vrahmapu॰ “gaNgAM puRyajalAM prApya caturdaSa vivarjayet । SOcamAcamanaM keSaM nirmAlyaM malaGarzaRam” । 2 pfkkAyAM strI Sabdara॰ ।
